requirement_text: Name and place of business of the manufacturer, packer or distributor
Statement of identity: the common or usual name of the device
The label and every device package bears a unique device identifier
UDI presented in both easily readable plain-text and AIDC form
UDI conforms to the standards of an FDA-accredited issuing agency (GS1 GTIN with valid check digit)
Production identifiers in the UDI (lot and expiration date) match the human-readable label
Dates on the label are formatted year-month-day (YYYY-MM-DD)
Prescription device labeling bears the symbol statement "Rx only" or the federal-law caution statement

regulation: FDA MR labeling guidance / ASTM F2503
requirement_text: Implants evaluated in the MR environment carry the MR safety marking
All required label statements appear in English
Label refers the user to the instructions for use where directions are supplied separately
Name or trade name of the device
Details strictly necessary to identify the device (catalogue/reference number)
Name, registered trade name or registered trade mark of the manufacturer and its registered place of business
Where the manufacturer is outside the Union: name and registered place of business of the authorised representative
Importer indicates its name, registered trade name and address on the device, its packaging or an accompanying document
Lot number or serial number preceded by LOT or SERIAL NUMBER or equivalent symbol
The UDI carrier
UDI-DI assigned according to the rules of a designated issuing entity (GS1 check digit valid)
UDI-PI (lot and expiry) in the carrier matches the human-readable information
Unambiguous indication of the time limit for using the device safely (at least year and month)
Any special storage and/or handling condition that applies
If supplied sterile: indication of sterile state and the sterilisation method
Warnings or precautions to be taken that need to be brought to the immediate attention of the user
If intended for single use: an indication of that fact
Sterile packaging: instruction on what to do if the sterile packaging is damaged or unintentionally opened
CE marking followed by the identification number of the notified body
Information supplied in the official Union language(s) determined by the Member State of sale
Indication to consult the instructions for use where an IFU is supplied
Implants evaluated in the MR environment carry the MR safety marking
Barcode GTIN equals the master GTIN registered for this SKU and packaging level
Symbols come from the current released library version
Symbols meet minimum height and nothing overlaps the UDI carrier
Label texts match approved master text; numbers, units and negations identical
Printed label revision matches the current released revision
Translations use approved glossary terms only
